chunks: And from him, from Sayf ibn 'Umeyra, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Salim al-Ashalli, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the prey of the trained dog who has eaten from its prey. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Eat from it'.

key_terms.صَيْد: Prey or game caught during hunting
key_terms.قَدْ أَكَلَ: Has eaten (consumed part of the prey)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat prey caught by a trained dog if the dog has eaten some of it?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Salim al-Ashalli inquires of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding the permissibility of consuming game caught by a trained dog that has eaten from it. The Imam’s affirmative ruling establishes that the dog's consumption does not render the prey impure or inedible, a key distinction in Shia fiqh regarding the conditions of *dhikr* and the dog's training. This narration underscores the practical flexibility in hunting laws, emphasizing the reliability of the trained hound as a valid instrument for slaughter.

en.hubeali: And from him, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Salim Al Ashalli who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the prey of the trained dog who has eaten from the prey. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat from it’.
